checks: Exported model build identity matches the source hashes of the solver, fixture, protocol and imported geometry
Isolated hover captures the same horizontal reference as its initial state and reports external through-flow separately from tank depletion
Finite hover distinguishes capacity loss, sustained tracking error and ground contact while conserving gas mass
Matched attitude A/B changes only the real stabilizer and requires a sustained low-error low-angular-rate recovery

Finite 900 L ground roll completes a full rotation and confirmed stable landing with conserved gas and remaining reserve; finite 600 L and 200 L preflight rejections leave state unchanged with no samples, impulse or gas use
Single-factor friction sweep keeps identical initial conditions and produces monotonic measured brake distances with confirmed stops
Fixed-wheel protocol exposes its assistance override while fixed-driver A/B retains an actual difference in road-wheel angle and logs speed accuracy
Identical model and protocol reproduce complete source curves at uniform 20 Hz and protocol identity ignores parameter ordering
Study archive import revalidates frozen requests, ignores supplied metrics and rejects oversized, non-finite or scientifically inapplicable protocols
